This is a Karameikos silver piece, called a "Crona".

On the coin's obverse is the royal palace in Specularum; on the reverse are the inscriptions, "Grand Duchy of Karameikos" and "One Crona."

This is a platinum piece, referred to as a "Crown" by merchants.

The inscription on the obverse of this coin indicates that it was minted in Glantri. Platinum pieces are rare and valuble, worth as much as a typical gold coin five times over.

This is a Karameikos copper piece, know as a "Kopec". 

On the coin's obverse is the great wolf of the inland forests; on the reverse are the inscriptions, "Grand Duchy of Karameios" and "One Kopec".
